blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Visayas grid is facing another red alert on Tuesday, with potential brownouts threatening residents and businesses amid tight power supply. In an advisory, the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines (NGCP) said the red alert status will be in effect from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m. READ: Visayas grid faces new yellow alert on Oct. 15 The region would likewise be under a yellow alert from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m. and from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. The NGCP said it declared the power alerts because two major coal plants in the Visayas were unavailable.
